newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares seen starting up, dollar supports.
newsitem.headline: French shares seen starting up, dollar supports.

text.p: French shares were seen opening higher, with the blue-chip index seen reclaiming territory above 2,550 on the first day of the May account, dealers said.

A steady dollar and bond prices supported the market, which was also drawing confidence on the outcome on the pending election from Tuesday's CSA opinion poll showing the centre-right would keep a majority.
The market is awaiting for new polls, expected at the end of the week. The April future contract on GLOBEX was trading 13 points up at 2,549.
